description: Protocol v1 section 23. `parseCases`: `raw` (an object, or a string of message text) through parsePageMessage; `valid` false means null, and `parsed` is the whole expected result. `nativeCases`: the same for parseNativeMessage (the hosted page reading an SDK message; text only). `urlCases`: appPageUrl. Layout differs from section 12 (`parseCases`, `nativeCases` and `urlCases` instead of `cases`).

parseCases.name: text: multibyte characters over the cap
text: escaped solidus in error code
text: lone high surrogate in id
text: px with whitespace around the number

nativeCases.name: puzzle: the largest (over the page-message cap)
puzzle: asset not a capability path
text: escaped quote in a token
text: raw control character in a string

urlCases.name: origin with an uppercase host (must be canonical)
origin with the default port spelled out
app id: android with a hyphen
app id: ios with an underscore
